notes: Encoded ONLY from Lincoln Barrièr's own page. Counting convention follows the Nordyne lesson applied page-internally: the page states positions as 'numerical digits', but digit-only counting is falsified by Style 1's own example (digit-only gives year '51', ambiguous below-floor/future, and week '65', invalid), while character counting decodes Style 1 cleanly (2005 week 16); character counting therefore governs all three styles on this page, including Style 2, where digit-only counting would give a different but plausible decode (2000 week 49) — that alternative is rejected because the page's own Style 1 example falsifies the digit-only convention, not because of any other page. No sisters are claimed; parent Goettl is a page fact, not a rule import.

styles.notes: Page positions 2nd & 3rd numerical digits = year, 4th & 5th = week (1-based characters), converted to 0-based half-open [1,3] and [3,5]. Character counting: '05' -> 2005, '16' -> week 16. Digit-only counting is falsified on this example (year '51' ambiguous, week '65' invalid).
